title: GtGenerator: command line, the class, foundation data, generators, data and version key
subtitle: Above: the command line, which calls only the class. Below: its sub-functions. Left to right: raw data, generators, stored data and key.

facade.label: class interface GtGenerator and what its methods call (not hashed)

found.label: foundation data: raw nuScenes and its readers (not hashed)

gen.label: generator, hashed into the GT signature

derived.label: derived output of a generator (not hashed)

store.label: stored data and version key (not hashed)

nodes.label:
python -m autogt
COMMAND
nodes.note: a thin map: the parser, and ONE call GtGenerator.<method>(**arguments) per command; it imports nothing else of the suite (a test pins that); exit 0 done, 1 not there / incomplete, 2 wrong arguments

nodes.label:
Look, check, tidy
view, report, clean
nodes.note: consistency checks, one PDF over all sequences, pictures, H.264 video, lane graph pictures, clean (never a released store), audit of a stored lane GT before its release

nodes.label:
class GtGenerator
one method per command
nodes.note: api.py = the static methods (generate, generate_bev_gt, generate_lane_gt, gt_key, have, check_data, audit_lane, area_masks, sets, versions, view, video, check, report, digest, clean, selftest ...); suite.py = the class GtGenerator (also the object that makes the GT of one keyframe), load(), the signatures; __init__.py = autogt.generate, load, missing ...

nodes.label:
Writer
generate, build, GT key
nodes.note: pipeline.py = THE front GT writer (groups of 60 sequences, resumable, workers as spawned processes); gt_api.py = generate_bev_gt / generate_lane_gt, which run the writer, the lane generator and the masks and return the GT key

nodes.label:
nuScenes raw
(D:, 850 sequences)
nodes.note: json tables, maps, CAM_FRONT (and the six cameras of the lane GT l4), five radars; data/NuScenes/ describes it and checks it (manifest.json); the data identity of the key is its hash

nodes.label:
Light reader
table cache
nodes.note: the nuScenes tables of just the sequences asked for, as the devkit's interface; ensure_cache reads the big tables once (92 s) and a group of 60 sequences then loads in 4 s

nodes.label:
Scene sets
raw-file check
nodes.note: small = the 10 sequences of mini, full = all 850; check_raw says whether every raw file the generators read is on disk

nodes.label:
Front GT generator
map, boxes, flow, masks
nodes.note: BEV layers, objects, velocity / flow in m/s, coverage masks per keyframe; the six files whose bytes make the front signature (6a7aa7864a, v9): editing one needs a versions.csv row, a tag and a rebuild of the BEV GT cache

nodes.label:
Lane GT generator
graph, tiers, two rigs
nodes.note: the lane graph, roads, lines, areas, tiers and camera visibility per point, for lane_center (Spurmitte) and bev_fusion; the six files of the lane signature (own versions); lane_gt.py also holds its own store code

nodes.label:
Area masks
(BEV grid, packed)
nodes.note: exact cell-centre raster of the lane polygons into the BEV grid, packed per frame below <lane store>/masks/; part of the BEV GT, not hashed

nodes.label:
Stores on disk
data/autogt
nodes.note: <signature>/<token>.npz (front), lane/<signature>/<token>.pkl.gz (+ masks/), cache/, reports/, examples/; data/autogt links to D:\Auto-research\NuScenesAdditionalGt

nodes.label:
Store files
index.json manifest
nodes.note: keyframe files, the index.json of a store folder (complete, scenes, stride, resolution, commit, dirty, release, data identity), resume checks, listing by file name

nodes.label:
GT key
GtKey, gt_key
nodes.note: data identity + per part (front / lane / masks) signature, store, version, commit, dirty; id over all parts; complete is never guessed; key.load / lane / mask read through it

nodes.label:
Versions, releases
signature -> v12
nodes.note: front version, lane version and release of a signature; same_gt_as aliases (new code, same GT: the old store is used); lane_l4_digest.json pins the l4 output for the l5 / l6 comparison, front_digests.json the front GT and the proof behind each same_gt_as

nodes.label: Tests: python -m autogt selftest
nodes.note: synthetic world with known truth, real keyframes, build + reload; every command is one method of GtGenerator and one call; exact raster against the polygons; generator against the devkit, the map and the image; lane graph invariants; the signature guard; each new test is checked by a mutant
